에버턴 and 리버풀 announce that they have abandoned plans to groundshare at 리버풀's new stadium , which is scheduled for completion in 2007. 노리치 시티 boost their survival hopes with a club record £3 million signing of 크루 알렉산드라 striker Dean Ashton .

German referee Robert Hoyzer admits to having accepted large sums of money from a gambling syndicate to fix matches . The resulting scandal was a major embarrassment to Germany as it prepared to host the 2006 FIFA World Cup . Eventually Hoyzer would be sentenced to two years and five months in prison.
former 첼시 chairman Ken Bates finalises a deal to buy a controlling interest in the debt-riddled Championship club 리즈 유나이티드 .

January draws to a close with 첼시 still top of the Premier League by an 11-point margin and their closest threat now coming from 맨체스터 유나이티드. 아스널, 에버턴 and 리버풀 complete the top five, while 미들즈브러 and 찰턴 애슬레틱 are level on points with 리버풀 in the race for a top-five place, though seventh place could be enough for a UEFA Cup place this season. 입스위치 타운, 위건 애슬레틱 and 선덜랜드 continue to lead the way at the top of the Championship. Reading, 셰필드 유나이티드 and 프레스턴 노스 엔드 complete the top six.
